title: HATCH pattern-name retained owner and base-reset release
mode: local fast implementation slice with generated controls
scope: Charge the parser-owned DXF HATCH group-2 pattern name to its entity retained-string owner
Preserve the field counter through HATCH copy, assignment, and move operations
Release the retained base lease when HATCH parser state is reset
Leave HATCH boundary semantics, gradient-name/color strings, and caller mutation outside this slice

implementation.summary: DRW_Hatch::parseCode now routes group-2 name through replaceDxfRetainedStringField with a dedicated byte counter. The explicit copy constructor/assignment preserve the counter; default move operations transfer it. A generated one-byte-under test exposed that the prior DRW_Hatch::resetDwgState did not call DRW_Point::resetDwgState, leaving the base shared retained lease charged after field reset. HATCH reset now invokes the base reset before clearing HATCH-specific state.
implementation.layoutChange: A private retained-byte counter was added to public DRW_Hatch layout. Downstream consumers must rebuild; binary ABI compatibility is not claimed.

assessment.claim: The selected parser-owned HATCH group-2 name is charged to the shared logical retained-byte budget, follows HATCH copy/move values, and is released by the now base-aware reset path. The one-byte-under control preserves the prior name/charge. Existing DXF fixture and HATCH tangent CLI checks show no observed regression in those routes; no broad HATCH semantic or DWG support claim follows.
assessment.coverage: Generated ASCII direct-parser controls verify minimum-cap discovery, successful replacement, one-byte-under refusal, copy construction/assignment, move construction/assignment, and final reset release. Existing hardening, DXF-fixture, and ASCII/Binary HATCH-tangent CLI CTests pass.
assessment.limitations: No HATCH gradient-name/color-string accounting, boundary semantics, complete-document support, external reader, native CAD, full suite, allocation benchmark, or support/J promotion was tested. Public post-parse mutation of name is not covered by parser-retained accounting.
